summary: End-to-end testing of the new Caras de Excavación matrix feature: GET/PUT/toggle/resumen endpoints, derived pilas/anclas counters, RBAC, PDF report (charts + caras section), avance-financiero, plus frontend integration. 15/15 backend tests PASS; frontend renders MatrizCarasExcavacion section under selected project with correct empty-state for unconfigured projects. One minor transient 401 on /caras-excavacion right after login.

minor.issue: Right after frontend login a transient 401 occurs (call fires before Authorization header is set in axios). The component recovers and renders correctly; worth a small fix to delay first fetch until token is present.

integration_issues.issue: Transient 401 on /api/proyectos/{id}/caras-excavacion (console error: 'Error cargando caras: AxiosError'). UI auto-recovers and shows empty state correctly, but generates two visible console errors per project switch.

action_items: Optional: in MatrizCarasExcavacion.jsx (and any other component that fetches caras), guard the initial fetch with a check that auth token is set, or rely on a global axios interceptor that delays requests until token is loaded. Prevents the harmless but noisy 'Error cargando caras: AxiosError 401' on first paint.

Optional UX: when the selected project has no caras configured AND user is admin, surface a direct link/button in matriz-no-configurada that opens the Edit Project form scrolled to CarasExcavacionConfig.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/caras_excavacion.py is clean (~250 lines), uses Pydantic min_length/max_length=4 for the caras list, normalizes state lengths defensively, and recalculates project pilas_planeadas/anclas_planeadas/pilas_ejecutadas/anclas_ejecutadas via _recalcular_totales_proyecto which also calls services.helpers.recalcular_avance_proyecto — consistent with the requested behavior.
Toggle endpoint correctly uses get_current_admin so clients receive 403 (verified). Read endpoints use get_current_user and validate clientes_asignados access.
Pydantic 2 syntax used (Field(min_length=4, max_length=4)); compatible with current backend.
_id is never included (find_one with {'_id': 0} projection) — good practice maintained.

success_rate.frontend: Pass — matriz section renders, empty state works, login/auth flows OK

seed_data_creation: Tests create and tear down a fresh project (TEST_CarasExcavacion_Project) per module; pre-existing 'Torre Mezquitan' / 'Proyecto Pilas Demo' / 'Torre Corporativa Demo' projects untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend feature tests for caras-excavacion live in /app/backend/tests/test_caras_excavacion.py (15 cases). Project creation requires fields: nombre, ubicacion, cliente, tipo_obra, presupuesto_total, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin_planeada, coordenadas (dict). Toggle endpoint requires admin; client gets 403. The configured-state E2E was verified via the existing 'Torre Mezquitan'-class projects but in this run the auto-selected first project had no caras configured, so the empty-state branch was exercised. To exercise the cells UI: log in as admin, click on 'Proyecto Pilas Demo' or 'Torre Corporativa Demo' in 'Proyectos Activos' panel (the agent's setup script seeded one of these with 12/12/8/8 pilas and 6/6/4/4 anclas).
rca_of_the_issue: Transient 401 on /caras-excavacion: the matriz component mounts and fires GET before the axios default Authorization header is set during the post-login redirect. Pattern is common across multiple components on this app; fix by adding a useEffect guard `if (!token) return;` or by replacing direct axios.get with the authenticated client instance that includes the interceptor. Not a regression — pre-existing pattern; this feature just adds another consumer that surfaces it.
